deadlines.label: Condominium Association Documents, Budget, Reserve Study and Milestone Inspection Report Delivered
deadlines.action: Deliver the declaration, bylaws, rules, budget, reserve study, milestone inspection report and the latest financial statements
deadlines.if_missed: Buyer's review period starts only when they arrive

deadlines.label: Buyer's Condominium Document Review and Rescission Period Ends
deadlines.action: Review every document and give written notice of cancellation if not proceeding
deadlines.if_missed: The right to cancel under the condominium review ends

deadlines.label: Association Purchase Approval Application and Interview Request Submitted
deadlines.action: Submit the association's purchase application, fee and background check consent
deadlines.if_missed: Association approval may not arrive before closing

deadlines.label: Association Approval of the Purchase Received in Writing
deadlines.action: Get the association's written approval of the sale and the buyers
deadlines.if_missed: Either party may cancel and the deposit is returned

deadlines.label: Special Assessment and Estoppel Certificate Ordered from the Association
deadlines.action: Order the estoppel certificate and disclose any pending special assessment

deadlines.label: Boundary and Elevation Survey with Flood Elevation Certificate Delivered
deadlines.action: Order the survey and the elevation certificate for the flood insurance quote
deadlines.if_missed: Survey objections may come after the title cure period

deadlines.label: Binding Flood Insurance Quote Received from the Buyer's Insurance Agent
deadlines.action: Get a binding flood and wind insurance quote for the lender

deadlines.label: Final Walk-Through and Personal Property Inspection
deadlines.action: Walk the unit and the storage locker and confirm repairs and personal property
deadlines.if_missed: Problems found after closing are harder to resolve
